result_summary.title: Attribution Engine audit logs missing entries in EU-West sandbox
result_summary.description: We are seeing gaps in the audit logs for the Attribution Engine within our EU-West sandbox environment. Specifically, there are missing entries that should be present. This is affecting visibility for about 2500 users and is currently considered a critical blocker for our compliance checks. Please investigate the log integrity immediately.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify and adjust the audit log configuration for the Attribution Engine in the EU-West sandbox environment.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The audit log configuration issue is the most likely cause of the missing entries in the Attribution Engine's audit logs, given the evidence of feature flag mismatches and configuration drift detected on the Audit Log Service. The root cause is likely a customer configuration error, and the affected component is the Audit Log Service. The owning team is the Compliance & Audit team.
